newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed firmer at 42.5480/5485 to the dollar in interbank trading, compared with previous 42.5490/5495, dealers said
The local unit was quoted stronger at 42.5475/5495 per dollar and retained the edge on increased selling offers from state-owned and foreign banks enjoying fresh remittance supply from wage earners.
"Deals were done at 42.5490 level in early trade but sellers eventually offered dollars at 42.5480," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed slightly up at 5.0 percent to 5.5 percent against the previous 4.5-5.0 percent, dealers said.
